versions.changelog:
- Initial release of LaunchFast Product Research Skill.
- Scan up to 10 Amazon product keywords in parallel using LaunchFast MCP.
- Score each keyword opportunity using LaunchFast's A10–F1 grading and custom opportunity score.
- Deliver clear Go / Investigate / Pass verdicts with concise rationale and key insights.
- Present results in an easy-to-read summary table and detailed deep-dives for top keywords.
- Offer targeted next steps: supplier search, IP check, PPC research, and full report options.
